Each identity must keep its request inter-arrival variance inside a narrow band around a fixed vertex value; agents whose traffic shape drifts toward the flat zenith of bursty automation get throttled. Enforcement compares a rolling window against the expected curve, so faking steady pacing forces the attacker to hold real idle gaps per identity, capping parallel throughput and multiplying the wall-clock cost of running N sybils.
